module.pdns_data.checks: Gathers the domain's DNS record history: CIRCL Passive DNS and AlienVault OTX (optional credentials) and Robtex (free).
module.pdns_data.fix:
Sort the history by date and spot the addresses and names that no longer appear in your current zone: former hosts, past migrations, retired environments.
For each old address: check that it no longer answers for your name (first command in the snippet); if it still hosts a service, terminate or move it, and confirm that no current record points to it.
For each old name: if it is no longer in your zone, there is nothing to delete in the DNS, but check that no CNAME dangles toward a terminated third-party service and that the certificates for that name are revoked or expired.
If the history reveals the origin address of a site protected by a CDN: limit the origin to the CDN's connections (see the snippet, address ranges to adapt), and if that server stayed reachable directly, ask your host for a new IP address.
Do not send mail or publish a direct record from the server's origin address: an MX, an SPF record or a message header would make it visible.
Third-party archives cannot be erased: consider any address that appears there as known to third parties, and run this scan again after every hosting change.
module.pdns_data.title: Passive DNS (history)
module.pdns_data.why: History shows the addresses and names the domain has used: former hosts, origin servers behind a CDN, forgotten services.
